product_family: Rask AI: AI-powered video and audio localization and dubbing platform supporting 130+ languages. Sub-products include VoiceClone (voice cloning), Rask API (for programmatic access), and various free tools (subtitle generator, transcription, etc.)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II Certified - Trusted by teams with strictest security requirements. SOC 2 Type II compliant and ready for enterprise review.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR compliant. Rask AI operates with a closed AI environment where customer content is never used for general model training, with strict data controls and isolation policies in place.
certifications.source: https://www.rask.ai/enterprise, https://www.rask.ai/compliance (implied via compliance page references)

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on vendor domain. ISO 27001 not mentioned in compliance pages, privacy policy, or terms of service. SOC 2 Type II is their primary information security certification.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Despite healthcare being listed as a use case on the enterprise page, there is no mention of HIPAA certification, BAA, or healthcare-specific compliance controls.

certifications.name: C2PA/Content Authenticity Initiative
certifications.proof_quote: Rask AI is an officially certified member of C2PA and Content Authenticity Initiative, demonstrating our commitment to media transparency.

privacy.ai_training_note: Rask AI operates a closed AI environment where customer content is never used for general model training. This is stated on the enterprise page and data protection policy. However, no explicit opt-out mechanism or granular control is mentioned in publicly available documentation.
privacy.data_region: United States (AWS infrastructure with multi-region replication for disaster recovery)

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 with AES-256 encryption (256-bit key) for HTTPS communications

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 (Advanced Encryption Standard with 256-bit key) for all databases, data stores, and file systems using Brask-managed keys

security.name: Key management
security.value: Automated key management with rotation at least every 12 months; access controls for designated users; secure backup and storage

security.name: Data separation
security.value: Customer data logically separated at database/datastore level using unique customer identifiers; API layer enforces separation via client authentication

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Employee production access disabled by default; requires approval; temporary access reviewed case-by-case by security team; API authentication required

security.name: Monitoring and logging
security.value: All access to production systems logged; Amazon CloudWatch monitoring for cloud services; activity and file integrity monitoring; vulnerability scanning; malware detection

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: AWS infrastructure with data replicated across multiple regions for redundancy and disaster recovery

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Customer data retained for duration of active account; deleted project media retained for up to 30 days; within 30 days of account termination, all customer data deleted

products.name: Rask AI Core Platform
products.data_scope: Customer video/audio content; personal data for account management
products.notes: Web-based SaaS platform supporting 130+ languages. Includes VoiceClone feature for voice cloning in 32 languages. Closed AI environment (no customer content used for general model training).

products.name: Rask API
products.data_scope: Same as core platform, accessed via API
products.notes: Allows automated video/audio translation and dubbing at scale. SOC 2 Type II and GDPR-compliant.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based (monthly and annual tiers, with free trial available; Creator and Creator Pro plans mentioned)

flags: ISO 27001 not held: Despite enterprise positioning, Rask AI does not appear to hold ISO 27001. This is notable for organizations requiring both SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance.

HIPAA not addressed: Healthcare is listed as a use case on the enterprise page, but no HIPAA certification or BAA is mentioned. Organizations handling health-related content should verify HIPAA eligibility directly with vendor.

DPA not explicitly mentioned: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy do not reference a formal Data Processing Agreement (DPA). GDPR compliance requires a DPA with customers; this may be available upon request for enterprise customers but is not publicly documented.

AI training policy clarity gap: While Rask states a closed AI environment with no customer data used for general model training, there is no explicit mention of an opt-out mechanism, granular controls, or specific restrictions on data use for vendor-controlled improvements.

Vanta trust center partially verified: Trust center URL provided (app.vanta.com/brask.ai/trust/fedkyiux0hug8sdsinpnwu) but detailed cert info could not be fully accessed. Recommend direct vendor contact or visiting Vanta portal for real-time verification.

Recent company (founded 2023): Rask AI was founded in 2023 by Maria Chmir and is backed by Brask Inc. While SOC 2 Type II suggests mature security practices, the company is still in growth phase. No evidence of outside funding found in public sources.
